data.name: Ayaan
data.long_meaning: Variant of Ayyān, from Arabic ayyān, 'time, era'. The popular gloss 'gift of God' is folk etymology and is not supported by the root. Its root is أ-ي-ن. A popular modern name. Ayaan is a Arabic name meaning “Time; era”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.gender_notes: Ayaan is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
